## Personality

Aunt Atossa is known for her sarcastic demeanor and malicious nature. She possesses a bitterness so pronounced that she seems to impart a negative quality to everything around her.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 ch.Evening P10](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0010)_

## History

Aunt Atossa became poor and lonely after her husband, Samson Coates, passed away, leading the [Wrights](../codex/factions.md#wrights) to take her into their [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) home. She previously spoke out aggressively during a church meeting in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stopped by the Wrights' home, where Aunt Atossa made several unpleasant comments to them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P18](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0018), [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), [v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), [v3 ch.Life P57](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0057)_

## Quotes

> "I suppose you got that notion out of some of those silly magazines you read so many of. I wonder your mother allows you. But she always spoiled you. We all thought when George married her she wouldn’t be a suitable wife for him."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P30](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0030)

> "Well, I suppose you can’t find much amusement talking to an old woman like me. It’s such a pity the boys ain’t home."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P32](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0032)

> "Mrs. Andrews was telling me you were home. She said you had improved a good deal."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022)

> "I never fancy your mother’s jelly—she always makes it too sweet. However, I’ll try to worry some down. My appetite’s been dreadful poor this spring. I’m far from well,"
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P26](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0026)

> "I hear you are to be married in June, Diana."
>
> — Aunt Atossa — [v3 ch.Life P36](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0036)

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-atossa--diana-barry.md)

Aunt Atossa is the paternal grand-aunt of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). During a journey to visit a sick friend, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) stop at the Wright household, where Aunt Atossa makes several unpleasant remarks toward them.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P18](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0018), [v3 ch.Life P22](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0022), +2 more_

- Relative of — paternal grand-aunt / aunt of father  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P18](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0018)</sub>
